title: Willow Kiteway
description: A high, wind-borne dance opens in wide melodic arcs, then gathers quick turning figures. A lower recollection briefly grounds it before rising thirds and sixteenth-note curls lift the tune again. The final gesture lands lightly on an open D.
technical_note: Treat the semiquaver turns as small continuous motions, with a loose wrist. Keep the bass in two large pulses while the melody alternates flowing runs and broader thirds. The quiet recollection should retain its momentum.

performance.note: Deliberate dance pulse, shaped phrases and terraced dynamics; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
